backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining track, playlist, user profile, background GIF management, and access‑controlled media library operations using storage and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two MP3‑related upload robustness features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of each major frontend file, including UI components, hooks, and styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point configuring meta tags, PWA manifest, favicon, and root mount for the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining Bonsai Radio’s name, icons, theme, colors, and startup configuration.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app orchestrating authentication, admin dashboard transitions, default GIF initialization, and theme setup.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistDia: Dialog for adding one or multiple tracks to selected playlists with batch mode support and mutation‑based backend updates.
frontend/src/components/AirPlayControl.t: UI control for triggering AirPlay device selection with availability checks, connection state styling, and optional tooltip.
frontend/src/components/AirPlayPlaybackA: Alert shown when AirPlay playback fails, offering retry actions with loading feedback.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundGifOve: Displays a GIF overlay that changes on track transitions with fade effects and user-configurable visual settings.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundVisual: Provides UI for uploading, deleting, previewing GIFs and adjusting background visual settings including transparency and randomization.
frontend/src/components/BatchEditTrackDi: Dialog for batch-editing track metadata with field selection, validation, and bulk update submission.
frontend/src/components/CreatePlaylistFo: Form for creating a playlist and uploading multiple audio tracks with metadata extraction and upload progress handling.
frontend/src/components/CreatePlaylistFr: Dialog for creating a playlist from existing library tracks with search, selection, and playlist ID input.
frontend/src/components/CyberpunkBackgro: Renders an audio-reactive cyberpunk visual background using canvas particles, flares, beams, and parallax effects.
frontend/src/components/DJAuthModal.tsx: Modal managing Internet Identity login, handling session checks, login attempts, success/error toasts, and UI states.
frontend/src/components/DJDashboard.tsx: Admin-only DJ dashboard displaying playlists and media data, with identity-based naming and logout handling.
Dialog for editing a track’s metadata with validation and mutation via updateTrackMetadata.
frontend/src/components/EmbeddedMusicPla: Feature-rich music player supporting playlists, buffered audio playback, AirPlay handling, audio analysis, and track navigation.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Full‑screen animated loading screen with branded visuals and pulsing elements.
frontend/src/components/MediaLibrary.tsx: Media library UI allowing search, sorting, batch selection, editing, deletion, and playlist creation for tracks.
frontend/src/components/MediaUploadDialo: Provides a dialog for selecting, validating, and uploading audio files with metadata extraction, progress tracking, and retry logic.
frontend/src/components/PlaylistList.tsx: Displays playlists and their tracks with basic metadata and play counts.
Main control panel with tabbed interfaces for creating playlists, viewing lists, managing media, playing music, and configuring visuals.
frontend/src/components/RadioPlayer.tsx: Web radio player handling playlist playback, listener sessions, buffering state, AirPlay support, and audio analysis.
frontend/src/components/StreamStabilityI: Shows a visual indicator of stream stability with color-coded states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAirPlay.ts: Manages AirPlay availability, connection state, and provides a method to open the device picker.
frontend/src/hooks/useAirPlayPlaybackRec: Handles automatic playback recovery after AirPlay route changes by reloading and resuming the audio element.
frontend/src/hooks/useAudioAnalyzer.ts: Provides a hook that initializes an audio analyzer and computes frequency-based metrics with adaptive throttling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context and provider for Internet Identity login, state management, and session restoration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for playlists, listener counts, sessions, background GIFs, and uploads using the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadSystemReadin: Checks whether the upload system is authorized, initialized, and ready, returning status and polling during initialization.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind layers and custom neon-themed variables and animations for the app’s styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/types/airplay.d.ts: Declares TypeScript types for Safari AirPlay-related media element events and properties.
frontend/src/utils/airplayBufferingStrat: Defines buffering configs and helper functions for detecting and recovering from AirPlay or normal playback buffering.
frontend/src/utils/audioFileUtils.ts: Provides utilities to validate audio files by MIME type or extension and extract durations using Web Audio API or HTMLAudioElement, plus helpers for parsing and formatting durations.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including support for hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theming, colors, animations, and container settings with plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing known issues, existing MP3‑upload related features, and a pending backend storage integration request.
